name: Orchestrator
description: This agent acts as the central coordinator of the system. Based on user input, it routes tasks to the appropriate specialized agent.

skills.name: Task Routing & Coordination
skills.description: Routes user queries between DiagnosisAgent, MatchingAgent, and AppointmentAgent based on the nature of the request.
examples: I think my sink is leaking, but I'm not sure how bad it is.
Can I fix this broken outlet myself or should I call an electrician?
Find me a plumber in Boston if it's not a DIY job.
I'd like to schedule an appointment with the electrician you found.
